dimensions.name: Abyssia
dimensions.tagline: An endless ocean that glows from below
dimensions.description: A planet without continents: one warm, endless ocean under a ringed moon, its reefs glowing cyan and magenta through the dark water, and the sea is strangely breathable. Giant kelp rises like cathedral columns, leviathan bones and pearl clams litter the trench floor. Lantern Eels light the way - the Deep Maw waits where the light runs out.

dimensions.name: Aerolith
dimensions.tagline: Meadow islands adrift in an endless sky
dimensions.description: Grassy islands float in tiers above a bottomless blue, spilling waterfalls into the clouds below. Sky Whales graze the air with gardens on their backs and Puffbirds nest in golden skyroots. Gravity is gentle here - but at night the Zephyr Wisps come out, and their gusts throw you off the edge.

dimensions.name: Aurum
dimensions.tagline: Everything here is gold. Everything.
dimensions.description: A world of gilded mountains under a honey-colored sky: the stone is veined with gold, the trees wear gold leaf and the meadows bloom with rubies and sapphires. Giant golden rings stand on the peaks and coins drift in the valleys like fallen leaves. Mind the Midas Golems that guard the summits - and never open a treasure chest you did not place yourself.

dimensions.name: Aviary Spires
dimensions.tagline: Spires above a sea of cloud, where the giant birds nest
dimensions.description: Stone spires a hundred blocks tall rise out of a soft white sea of cloud, catching the pink light of a dawn that never quite ends. Their summits are crowned with nests the size of houses, full of sky-blue eggs and fluffy Nestlings - and watched over by the Rocs, who do not like visitors near their young. Fall off and the clouds will catch you. Probably.

dimensions.name: Brickton
dimensions.tagline: Snapped together, one stud at a time
dimensions.description: A whole world built from studded plastic toy bricks: red mesas, blue bays, yellow flats and green baseplate meadows, with giant cubes floating overhead where somebody forgot to finish building. Block Dogs bound along the studs and the Brick Golems keep things tidy. Watch out for Brick Raiders lobbing bricks from the ramparts - and never, ever step on a loose brick barefoot.

dimensions.name: Colossia
dimensions.tagline: A garden so big you are the bug
dimensions.description: Step through and everything is enormous - or you are tiny. Grass blades tower like green skyscrapers, flowers bloom on stalks thirty blocks tall, dewdrops sit on the lawn like glass boulders and pebbles are mountains. The Titan Snail is harmless, if you can get out of its way; the Giant Ants and Mega Bees are friendly until you touch their stuff.

dimensions.name: Cronenberg World
dimensions.tagline: Everything here is alive. Everything here is wrong.
dimensions.description: A planet that mutated into one continuous body: hills of pulsing flesh, forests of bone, eyes growing on stalks and a sea of dark ichor under a sky with an eye in it. The Cronenbergs that used to be people roam in packs, Flesh Crawlers skitter through the veins, and the Gut Worms only bite if you step on them. Do not stay after dark - it is always nearly dark.

dimensions.name: Effervescia
dimensions.tagline: A fizzy soda sea that tickles your feet
dimensions.description: A warm, endless soda sea - cola in the deeps, lime in the lagoons, berry fizz in the shallows - with islands of whipped foam floating on top. Lemon slices bigger than houses drift past giant striped straws, ice cubes bob in the swell and soap bubbles hang in the carbonated air, which makes everything (you included) a little floaty. Nothing here means you harm; the Fizzers just like to share.

dimensions.name: Ember Savanna
dimensions.tagline: The sun never quite finishes setting
dimensions.description: An endless golden savanna held forever in the last minute of sunset, under a swollen red sun that never sinks. Flat-topped thornwood trees and giant baobabs stand against the glow, and termite cathedrals taller than houses smoke quietly in the red pans. Herds of Stripe Grazers and gentle Longnecks roam the grass - and so do the Dust Lions, which hunt from the tall grass at dusk.

dimensions.name: Eventide
dimensions.tagline: The blue hour that never ends
dimensions.description: The sun set here a thousand years ago and the sky never finished darkening. Violet meadows hum with fireflies, silverbark forests hold up canopies of blue leaves, and moonpools glow under a moon too big for the sky. Moonfoxes and owls are friendly enough - just give the antlered Shade Stags the right of way.

dimensions.name: Froopyland
dimensions.tagline: Frosting hills, gumdrop trees and rivers of chocolate
dimensions.description: A sugar-coated paradise of pink frosting hills, gumdrop groves and giant swirl lollipops, cut by slow rivers of chocolate. Gummy bears wobble across the meadows and Lollicorns graze the mint frosting. Mind the Jawbreakers on the rock candy ridges - they bounce harder than they look.

dimensions.name: Gearhaven
dimensions.tagline: A world that runs on steam and never stops ticking
dimensions.description: Someone wound this world up and walked away. Brass-plated terraces step up toward smokestacks and clock spires, gears the size of houses stand half-buried in verdigris, and copper pipes arch over hissing steam vents. Brass Automatons keep the place running and dislike being interrupted; Cogspiders skitter out of the machinery looking for spare parts - yours.

dimensions.name: Glacior
dimensions.tagline: Frozen peaks under a sky that never stops dancing
dimensions.description: An ice age that never ended: glacier-walled mountains, a frozen sea locked under pack ice, and blue ice caverns full of humming crystals, all under a green-and-violet aurora that never fades. Snow Hoppers bound through the frostpine woods. Ice Beetles lurk where the glaciers crack, and the Frost Yeti does not like being followed.

dimensions.name: The Glitch
dimensions.tagline: Reality.exe has stopped responding
dimensions.description: A corrupted save file of a world: magenta-and-black missing textures, cubes of terrain hanging in the air, fields of humming TV static and grass that renders one tile to the left. Space itself skips here - expect to be teleported a few blocks without warning. The Corrupted Cows are harmless; the Pixel Wraiths and the hungry Missingno are not.

dimensions.name: Gloopolis
dimensions.tagline: Everything here wobbles. Including you.
dimensions.description: A slime world where the hills are glossy goo that bounces back underfoot, raspberry jelly fills the lakes and wobbling slime pillars glow aqua at their tips. Giant soap bubbles roll across the Bubble Fields and Blob Grazers munch goo sprouts by the herd. Mind the Bounce Slimes - they hop straight for your face and split when you hit them.

dimensions.name: Groovy
dimensions.tagline: Turn on, tune in, float away.
dimensions.description: A lava lamp the size of a universe: blobs of glowing wax drift through an orange-and-purple haze above a molten sea, and some of them are big enough to stand on. Shag meadows sprout giant flower-power daisies, disco fields flash under spinning mirror balls and the gravity is far out, man. Everything here is friendly - just don't upset a Lava Lamp Blob, and don't look down.

dimensions.name: Harvestfall
dimensions.tagline: Eternal autumn under the harvest moon
dimensions.description: The sun is always setting on Harvestfall, and an enormous orange moon is always rising. Maple forests burn crimson and gold, leaves drift down forever, and pumpkins grow as big as cottages in the fields. Squirrels hoard acorns and crows watch from every branch. Stay out of the cornfields at dusk: the Scarecrows there are not holding still.

dimensions.name: Hivemind
dimensions.tagline: You are inside the hive. The hive knows.
dimensions.description: A world that is one colossal beehive: endless hexagonal chambers walled in honeycomb, wax halls lit by royal jelly, golden honey pooling in the lower cells and amber galleries where ancient bees sleep in glowing stone. Wax Grubs inch along the floors and Hive Drones patrol in buzzing squads - leave them be. Wherever the larvae are kept, the Hive Warden is never far.

dimensions.name: Inversia
dimensions.tagline: Meadows hang from a stone sky above the void
dimensions.description: Somebody turned this world upside down and forgot to tell gravity. Meadows hang from a stone sky, trees grow downward with lantern pods at their tips, and a blue planet glows far below your feet. Root Grazers browse the dangling roots, but Ceiling Crawlers drop from above - and one bite makes you fall the wrong way. Do not step off the islands.

dimensions.name: Jurassica
dimensions.tagline: Steaming fern jungles where the dinosaurs never left
dimensions.description: A hot, wet, prehistoric world: jungles of tree ferns and cycads, open plains where Brontobacks graze in thundering herds, bubbling tar pits full of old bones and volcanoes smoking on the ridges. A comet hangs in the afternoon sky. The Pterodons only mind you near their nests - the Raptors hunt in packs and they are faster than you.

dimensions.name: Lotus Delta
dimensions.tagline: A warm, misty delta of giant lily pads
dimensions.description: A slow golden morning that never ends, over a maze of shallow channels and reed islands. Lily pads here are big enough to camp on, and lotus blossoms taller than a house glow softly at their hearts. Lily Toads sing from the pads while Dragonflies zip through the mist. Only the Mud Crocs spoil the calm - watch the muddy shallows for a pair of yellow eyes.

dimensions.name: Lumina
dimensions.tagline: A jungle that glows in an endless night
dimensions.description: A jungle where the sun never rose and every living thing learned to make its own light: cyan sap veins, lantern bulbs and magenta Moonblooms taller than houses. Glow Frogs sing in luminous lagoons and Lantern Bugs drift like slow sparks. Keep to the light - the Lumi Panther hunts where the glow runs out, and you will only see its eyes.

dimensions.name: Mesa Rift
dimensions.tagline: Red-rock canyons under a wide golden sky
dimensions.description: A sun-baked world of striped red cliffs cut by deep canyons, with turquoise rivers winding along their floors. Hoodoos stand in silent crowds, stone arches span the badlands and condors nest on the painted bluffs. Rock lizards bask everywhere - but listen for the rattle before you step over a ledge.

dimensions.name: Microverse
dimensions.tagline: You are smaller than you have ever been.
dimensions.description: Shrink below a micron into a living tissue sample: towering pink cell walls stained like a lab slide, a sea of cytoplasm, glowing purple nuclei the size of hills and orange mitochondria humming with energy. Paramecia glide through the cytoplasm, but Amoebas creep along the membranes and Phages - six-legged viral walkers - hunt anything with DNA. Something enormous is looking down through the lens.

dimensions.name: Oculus Swamp
dimensions.tagline: The swamp that stares back
dimensions.description: A violet bog under a sky full of open eyes. Eyeballs grow on fleshy stalks, lily pads blink, and black pupil-pools ringed with glowing irises dilate as you pass. Eyebats flutter harmlessly, but the Floating Eyes fire bolts that drag at your legs, and Bog Lurkers wait under the water with too many eyes of their own.

dimensions.name: Orbitas
dimensions.tagline: A thousand tiny worlds, one giant sky
dimensions.description: Space, but cosy: hundreds of tiny planets hang in the starry dark, each one its own little world - grassy ones with baobab trees, molten ones with cracked glowing crusts, icy ones bristling with comet spikes, and bare asteroids studded with stardust ore. The air is thin and gravity is gentle, so you can almost jump between them. Void Rays glide past like ships; Comet Imps pelt you with ice. Do not miss the jump.

dimensions.name: Ossuary
dimensions.tagline: A bone desert where giants came to die
dimensions.description: Endless dunes of bleached bone-sand under a sour amber sky and a cracked, skull-white moon. Ribcages of colossal beasts arch out of the Colossus Graveyard, skull totems mark the old trails and the Marrow Flats bubble red and sticky. Vultures circle patiently - something long and rattling swims beneath the sand, and after dark the skulls start to crawl.

dimensions.name: Paradisia
dimensions.tagline: Sun, surf and absolutely no problems
dimensions.description: Islands of white and pink sand ringed by water so turquoise it looks fake, with leaning palms heavy with coconuts and jungle hills full of hibiscus. Under the lagoons the coral reefs glow at night, and great limestone sea stacks rise out of the shallows like green-crowned towers. Nothing here wants to hurt you - though the Coconut Monkeys will absolutely steal your snacks.

dimensions.name: Plushland
dimensions.tagline: Everything is soft. Everything is stitched.
dimensions.description: A world sewn together from felt and stuffing: the hills are mint-green felt patches, the trees are knitted pom-poms on yarn-wrapped trunks and the meadows grow buttons instead of flowers. Giant balls of wool lie in the downs and the pillow hills are soft enough to bounce on. Plush Bears and Yarn Cats will happily follow you home; the Button Spiders only mind if you poke them.

dimensions.name: Prismara
dimensions.tagline: Crystal caverns that glow in every colour
dimensions.description: A sunless world of vast caverns where crystal spires the size of towers glow cyan and magenta and still prism lakes mirror them. Shimmer Moths drift between the lamps and Geode Golems sleep in the vaults. Listen for clicking: Crystal Crawlers hunt in the darker hollows, and the shard fields cut deep.

dimensions.name: Pyroclast
dimensions.tagline: Ash falls like snow on a world that never cooled
dimensions.description: A volcanic hellscape under a shattered moon: black basalt ranges, obsidian spires, magma fields that crack and glow underfoot and lava rivers that drain into a sea of fire. Ash never stops falling and the heat gnaws at you. The Magma Tripods are calm until provoked - the Cinder Imps and Ash Crawlers never are.

dimensions.name: Radlands
dimensions.tagline: Don't drink the water. Don't touch the rocks. Don't stay.
dimensions.description: A burnt-out world after the bombs: cracked ash flats under a mustard sky, dead forests of bleached trunks and pools that glow an awful green. The rocks themselves are hot here - stepping on glowrock poisons you - but uranium waits inside them. Mutant Rats hunt in packs, Sludge Blobs ooze out of the pools, and the Glowing Ghouls are drawn to anything that is still warm.

dimensions.name: Rubra
dimensions.tagline: Rust, dust and two moons in a hurry
dimensions.description: A cold red planet under a butterscotch sky, where the sunsets are blue and two pebble-sized moons race each other overhead. Every step is a bound in the thin gravity; dust storms swallow the basins and rime of frozen air crusts the poles. Old landers rust half-buried in the dunes - and on the highlands, tall three-legged things still patrol, burning anything that moves.

dimensions.name: Sakura Heights
dimensions.tagline: Cherry-blossom terraces where it is always spring
dimensions.description: Green terraces climb into the mist, every step crowned with cherry trees in full bloom and petals drifting on the breeze. Bamboo groves creak in the valleys, koi circle in still ponds beneath vermilion spirit gates, and paper lanterns float by themselves at dusk. The white Spirit Foxes are gentle - unless you are not.

dimensions.name: Saltara
dimensions.tagline: Blinding salt flats and rose-pink lakes
dimensions.description: A perfectly flat white world under a perfectly blue sky - bring sunglasses. The salt crust cracks into endless polygons, brine lakes glow rose pink, and halite crystals the size of houses grow wherever the brine springs bubble up. Long-legged Stiltbirds wade the lakes, Salt Crabs scuttle over the crust and Brine Shrimp tint the water. Nothing here wants to hurt you; the sun might.

dimensions.name: Scrapheap
dimensions.tagline: Somewhere, everything ever thrown away ends up here
dimensions.description: A whole planet of junk under a smog-orange sky and a shattered moon: rust-dust plains, mountains of compacted scrap, black oil fens and the rusting skeletons of machines the size of cathedrals, their gears half-sunk in the dust. Rust Rats scatter at your footsteps and the Junk Golems only fight if you start it - but the Scrap Drones shoot first and never ask.

dimensions.name: Selene
dimensions.tagline: Magnificent desolation, low gravity included
dimensions.description: The Moon - or a moon very like it. Grey regolith rolls between craters under a black, star-filled sky where a blue planet hangs forever. Every jump is a leap; ice and glowing moonstone hide in the shadowed craters. Moon Hoppers bound between the rims and Crater Crabs keep to themselves. Somewhere out on the Sea of Tranquility stands a black monolith that hums when you touch it.

dimensions.name: Shattered Realm
dimensions.tagline: The broken pieces of a world, adrift in the void
dimensions.description: Something cracked this world like an egg: what remains are islands of torn earth drifting in an endless violet void, pierced by obsidian shards the size of towers and littered with the floating ruins of whoever lived here. Rift crystals glow in the cracks and Void Jellies drift between the fragments - their gel will save you from a long fall. Rift Stalkers step out of thin air and Shard Wraiths hurl splinters of the broken sky; one bad step and the void takes you.

dimensions.name: The Sketchbook
dimensions.tagline: A world still being drawn in pencil
dimensions.description: Everything here is drawn: ruled-paper meadows, crosshatched forests, a doodled sun and ink-blot lakes as black as a fountain pen. Wander far enough and the world fades into blank paper, where giant pencils stand waiting to finish it. Doodle Dogs will follow anyone with paper and Paper Cranes glide overhead, but the Scribble Beast is an angry tangle of ink that bites.

dimensions.name: Snackrealm
dimensions.tagline: Bread hills, cheese cliffs and fizzy soda springs
dimensions.description: A world that smells like a bakery: rolling bread-crust hills, swiss-cheese cliffs riddled with holes, pepperoni plains and broccoli trees as big as oaks, all under a fried-egg sun. Soda springs fizz and spout and the sea is cola. Cheese Mice nibble everything; the Meatballs are grumpy but small, and splitting them only makes more meatballs.

dimensions.name: Spectra
dimensions.tagline: Rolling hills striped in every colour there is
dimensions.description: A gentle world where light itself got spilled: hills banded in pastel rainbow strata, quilted meadows of rose, mint and gold, and rainbow-leaved groves that rustle in seven colours. Stained-glass Prism Towers glitter on the crystal heights and every river runs a different hue. Prism Unicorns graze the meadows and nothing here wants to hurt you - though the Chroma Slimes do sulk if poked.

dimensions.name: Spectral Vale
dimensions.tagline: A moor where it is always midnight and never quiet
dimensions.description: A fog-drowned moor stuck at the stroke of midnight: dead trees claw at a huge pale moon, crooked gravestones lean in rows nobody remembers planting, and soulfire hisses up through the bogs. Will-o'-Wisps drift between the barrows and light your way - but the Bone Hounds hunt in packs, and the Wraiths come from wherever the fog is thickest.

dimensions.name: Spinelands
dimensions.tagline: Everything here has a point
dimensions.description: A world grown entirely of spikes: rock spires like teeth, black needle forests, bone-white quills longer than a house and brambles that bite through boots. Deep in the hollows the bloodroses open huge and beautiful and drip sweet amber ichor. Thorn Hogs bristle when you come close, Needle Birds shoot quills from the treetops, and the Spine Crawlers climb whatever you are hiding on.

dimensions.name: Sporewood
dimensions.tagline: Twilight forests of towering glowcaps
dimensions.description: A world locked in permanent dusk where mushrooms grow taller than trees and glow in teal and violet - the Elder Glowcaps are taller than any tower you have built. Spores drift through the air like snow and fairy rings ring the meadows. Sporelings wander the moss, Puffjellies drift over the fens, but something tall and thin stalks the darker hollows.

dimensions.name: Synthwave
dimensions.tagline: Neon grids racing toward an endless sunset
dimensions.description: A world rendered in 1986: glowing magenta grid plains run to a striped sun that never finishes setting, chrome mesas wear neon-trimmed edges, and cyan palms line the boulevards. Hyperdrive strips fling you forward and bounce pads fling you up. Neon Panthers prowl the mesas - leave them be - and Glitch Cubes skip through space to bite.

dimensions.name: Tempestus
dimensions.tagline: The storm never ends here
dimensions.description: A planet trapped inside a hurricane that has been raging for a million years. Lightning hammers the black crags every few heartbeats, copper halos hum in mid-air and whole fields crackle with static that will bite through your boots. Storm Elementals hurl ball lightning from the clouds and Thunderbirds guard the peaks - only the Static Slugs seem to enjoy it.

dimensions.name: Thermalia
dimensions.tagline: Hot springs, steam and a sky-high spa day
dimensions.description: A tidally-heated moon of a great amber gas giant, its every hillside stepped into cream travertine terraces brimming with turquoise pools. Geysers thunder plumes into the steam, prismatic springs bloom orange and blue, and the warm vents heal whoever lingers. Steam Turtles graze the tree-fern gullies; mind the scalding mud pots, and the Sulfur Toads that spit from the yellow flats.

dimensions.name: Umbra
dimensions.tagline: Where light goes to be eaten
dimensions.description: A realm of caverns so dark that your torch seems to shrink. Trails of living crystal glow in the black like veins, leading - maybe - somewhere, and gentle Glimmers carry their own light through the galleries. Every so often the darkness pulses and swallows your sight. Umbral Hounds hunt by smell, and the Shades only move when the light goes out.

dimensions.name: Vitrea
dimensions.tagline: Glass dunes burning under twin suns
dimensions.description: Two suns have baked this desert until the sand itself turned to glass: dunes glitter, lightning leaves fulgurite spires behind, and rose-glass arches throw pink light across the sand. Crystal cacti bloom, oases shimmer - check before you drink, half of them are mirages. Dune Striders are gentle; Glass Scorpions are not, and the dunes themselves sometimes open up with teeth.

dimensions.name: The White Room
dimensions.tagline: Nothing here. Nothing at all. Probably.
dimensions.description: A perfectly flat white floor under a perfectly white sky, stretching until the horizon simply stops. Black monoliths stand at impossible distances and some of them hover; nobody knows who left the footprints. The Faceless wander here politely. The Silhouettes do not - and in the Negative, where everything is inverted, you will not see them coming at all.

items.name: Glow Pearl
items.lore: Still warm. Something in it is breathing.

items.name: Bubble Jelly
items.lore: Pops on the tongue. You can breathe the bubbles.

items.name: Deep Maw Fang
items.lore: Glows faintly at the root, like a lure.

items.name: Cloudberry
items.lore: Light as air. Eat one before you jump, not after.

items.name: Puff Feather
items.lore: So light it falls upward on windy days.

items.name: Sky Whale Pearl
items.lore: Hold it to your ear: you can hear a whale singing far above.

items.name: Greed Gem
items.lore: Everybody wants one. That is the whole problem.

items.name: Midas Fig
items.lore: Heavy as a coin purse. Sweet as getting away with it.

items.name: Midas Heart
items.lore: Still warm. Still counting.

items.name: Roc Feather
items.lore: Hold it up in a strong wind and your feet start getting ideas.

items.name: Cloudberry
items.lore: Weighs less than nothing. Eat two and hold on to something.

items.name: Loose Brick
items.lore: The most dangerous object in the multiverse to step on barefoot.

items.name: Power Stud
items.lore: Click.

items.name: Snap-On Sandwich
items.lore: Bread, cheese, lettuce, bread. Clicks together. Builds character.

items.name: Mega Honey Glob
items.lore: One drop from a Mega Bee. Enough for a whole picnic.

items.name: Giant Ant Chitin
items.lore: Light as paper, strong as a door.

items.name: Titan Shell Shard
items.lore: A flake the size of a shield. The snail did not notice it was missing.

items.name: Mystery Meat
items.lore: It was probably somebody. Tastes like chicken anyway.

items.name: Watching Eye
items.lore: Still blinks when nobody looks at it.

items.name: Gut String
items.lore: Like string, but worse in every measurable way.

items.name: Fizz Pop
items.lore: Shake well. Then run.

items.name: Soda Cherry
items.lore: Burp responsibly.

items.name: Everlasting Bubble
items.lore: Never pops in your pocket. Only in your face.

items.name: Sunset Marula
items.lore: Ripens in the last light. Which is always.

items.name: Dust Lion Mane
items.lore: Still smells of smoke and bad decisions.

items.name: Moonpetal
items.lore: Tastes like the last minute of a sunset.

items.name: Shade Antler
items.lore: Its tips still glow, as if it remembers the stag.

items.name: Moonfox Tuft
items.lore: Impossibly soft. Shed, not taken - moonfoxes leave them for friends.

items.name: Gummy Chunk
items.lore: Still wobbling. So are your knees.

items.name: Lollicorn Horn Candy
items.lore: Shed every spring. Tastes like a rainbow's aftertaste.

items.name: Jawbreaker Shard
items.lore: Do not bite. Suck patiently for roughly three weeks.

items.name: Wind-Up Biscuit
items.lore: Turn the key twice before eating.

items.name: Loose Cog
items.lore: Twelve teeth. No idea where it goes.

items.name: Mainspring
items.lore: Wound tight enough to run a city for a week.

items.name: Yeti Fur
items.lore: Impossibly warm. Smells faintly of peppermint.

items.name: Snowberry
items.lore: Crunchy, fizzy, and it makes your feet bouncy.

items.name: Frost Carapace
items.lore: Cold enough to keep a drink chilled for a week.

items.name: Corrupted Beef
items.lore: Tastes like beef.png failed to load.

items.name: Missing Fragment
items.lore: Item name not found. Item lore not found. Item not f

items.name: Bounce Jelly
items.lore: Eat it and your knees forget how gravity works.

items.name: Gloopberry
items.lore: Squishes between your teeth. Glows a little on the way down.

items.name: Goo Glob
items.lore: Still trying to crawl back to the lake.

items.name: Groove Jelly
items.lore: Your feet will not stop. Do not fight it.

items.name: Disco Shard
items.lore: Every face catches a different colour of light.

items.name: Warm Wax Drop
items.lore: Rises when warm, sinks when cool. So do you, apparently.

items.name: Candy Corn
items.lore: Found stuffed in a scarecrow's pockets. Nobody knows who put it there.

items.name: Golden Acorn
items.lore: Squirrels will follow you anywhere for one of these.

items.name: Sweetcorn
items.lore: Sweet enough to eat raw, warm from the evening sun.

items.name: Royal Jelly
items.lore: Meant for a queen. You will do.

items.name: Amber Chunk
items.lore: Something small is still in there, waiting.

items.name: Drone Stinger
items.lore: Still twitches when it hears buzzing.

items.name: Lantern Pod
items.lore: Falls up if you let go of it. Eat it and so do you, a little.

items.name: Gravity Silk
items.lore: Spun by Ceiling Crawlers. It drifts toward the sky.

items.name: Raptor Claw
items.lore: Sharper than it has any right to be. Count your fingers.

items.name: Bronto Rib
items.lore: One rib. Roughly the size of a canoe.

items.name: Bronto Roast
items.lore: Feeds a family of twelve. Or one very tired explorer.

items.name: Lotus Root
items.lore: Crunchy, sweet, and full of little tunnels.

items.name: Mud Croc Scute
items.lore: Thick as a roof tile. The croc did not give it up willingly.

items.name: Dragonfly Wing
items.lore: Shimmers green, then blue, then a colour you have no name for.

items.name: Lumen Fruit
items.lore: Eat one and the dark stops being dark for a while.

items.name: Lumi Panther Fang
items.lore: Still faintly glowing. So is the bite mark.

items.name: Lantern Dust
items.lore: Shaken from a Lantern Bug. It glows for weeks.

items.name: Rift Turquoise
items.lore: The colour of the river, if the river were very old and very patient.

items.name: Prickly Pear
items.lore: Sweet, cool, and only slightly stabby.

items.name: Serpent Rattle
items.lore: Shake it and every lizard on the mesa freezes.

items.name: ATP Pellet
items.lore: Pure cellular energy. Do not chew.

items.name: Phage Capsid
items.lore: Twenty perfect faces and one terrible idea inside.

items.name: Cytoplasm Jelly
items.lore: Mostly water, a little salt and a lot of enthusiasm.

items.name: Pickled Eye
items.lore: It blinks if you shake the jar.

items.name: Watcher's Lens
items.lore: Look through it, and something looks back.

items.name: Starfruit
items.lore: Tastes like a wish. Eat one before you jump.

items.name: Stardust
items.lore: Swept up from the floor of the universe.

items.name: Comet Shard
items.lore: Still cold enough to burn.

items.name: Bone Marrow
items.lore: Rich, buttery, and none of your business whose it was.

items.name: Serpent Vertebra
items.lore: Still rattles faintly when the others are near.

items.name: Coconut
items.lore: Crack it on a rock, drink the inside, swim like a fish.

items.name: Sea Glass
items.lore: A bottle, a thousand tides, and a crab with taste.

items.name: Teddy Fluff
items.lore: Premium unbleached teddy stuffing. Smells faintly of bedtime.

items.name: Lucky Button
items.lore: Four holes. Endless possibilities.

items.name: Felt Cookie
items.lore: Made of felt. Tastes like cookie anyway. Nobody asks how.

items.name: Prism Shard
items.lore: Splits torchlight into seven colours and one that has no name.

items.name: Geode Heart
items.lore: Still warm. Still beating, very slowly.

items.name: Crystal Crawler Leg
items.lore: Crunchy outside, luminous inside. You will glow for a while.

items.name: Fire Opal
items.lore: There is a tiny storm of fire trapped inside.

items.name: Cinder Pepper
items.lore: Eat one and the lava feels like a warm bath. For a while.

items.name: Magma Core
items.lore: It beats like a heart. A very hot heart.

items.name: Uranium Shard
items.lore: Warm to the touch. Then warmer. Put it down.

items.name: Mutant Jerky
items.lore: Three-eyed rat, sun-dried. Might let you see in the dark. Might not.

items.name: Glowshroom Cap
items.lore: It glows because it is radioactive. You will glow because you ate it.

items.name: Martian Blueberry
items.lore: Not a berry. Not blue. Not technically edible. Crunchy, though.

items.name: Heat-Ray Lens
items.lore: Still warm. Point it away from your face.

items.name: Skimmer Silk
items.lore: Thin enough to read through, strong enough to ride a dust storm.

items.name: Sakura Mochi
items.lore: Left as an offering. The lantern did not mind sharing.

items.name: Spirit Fox Tuft
items.lore: Warm to the touch, and it smells faintly of blossoms and rain.

items.name: Lantern Ember
items.lore: A little flame that has forgotten how to burn things.

items.name: Rock Salt
items.lore: A perfect cube, every time. Saltara is very particular.

items.name: Brine Shrimp
items.lore: Stiltbirds eat thousands a day. That is why Stiltbirds are pink.

items.name: Stiltbird Plume
items.lore: Light enough to float on brine. Pink enough to be suspicious.

items.name: Scrap Bolt
items.lore: Fits nothing. Fits everything. Depends how hard you hit it.

items.name: Drone Core
items.lore: Still warm. Still angry.

items.name: Questionable Jerky
items.lore: Chewy, metallic, and probably rat.

items.name: Moon Cheese
items.lore: It was cheese all along.

items.name: Helium-3 Crystal
items.lore: Fuel for a fusion reactor, or a very fancy balloon.

items.name: Void Jelly Gel
items.lore: Eat it before the jump. It remembers what falling gently felt like.

items.name: Wraith Splinter
items.lore: A sliver of the broken sky. It hums in the key of the void.

items.name: Rift Heart
items.lore: Still beating. Every beat is a tiny tear in the world.

items.name: Living Ink
items.lore: It keeps trying to finish a drawing you cannot see.

items.name: Doodled Apple
items.lore: Two lines and a leaf. Surprisingly crunchy.

items.name: Meatball
items.lore: Still rolling around a bit. Perfectly seasoned.

items.name: Cheese Wedge
items.lore: Aged to perfection by a very proud mouse.

items.name: Pretzel Twist
items.lore: Salt rush! Shed by a Pretzel Snake. It doesn't mind.

items.name: Prism Shard
items.lore: Hold it up to the light and it hums in seven notes.

items.name: Chroma Gel
items.lore: Tastes like whichever colour you were thinking of.

items.name: Rainbow Mane
items.lore: Shed, never cut. Unicorns are very particular about that.

items.name: Ectoplasm
items.lore: Cold, wobbly, and faintly humming a funeral march.

items.name: Bottled Wisp
items.lore: Drink the light. Try not to think about where it came from.

items.name: Hound Fang
items.lore: Still snaps shut on its own if you leave it on a table.

items.name: Hog Quill
items.lore: Barbed both ways. Pull it out slowly. No, slower.

items.name: Rose Hip
items.lore: Sweet, tart and only slightly stabby.

items.name: Needle Feather
items.lore: Each barb is sharp enough to sew with. Several have.

items.name: Glowcap Slice
items.lore: Tastes like blue raspberry and dirt

items.name: Stalker Spore
items.lore: It is warm, and it is not entirely sure it is dead.

items.name: Puffjelly Gel
items.lore: Lighter than air for about fifteen seconds.

items.name: 8-Bit Drumstick
items.lore: Low resolution. High flavour.

items.name: Neon Filament
items.lore: Still warm. Still humming in B minor.

items.name: Glitch Shard
items.lore: Hold it to your ear: dial-up tones.

items.name: Storm Core
items.lore: Crackles when you shake it. Do not shake it.

items.name: Thunder Feather
items.lore: Smells of ozone. Your hair stands up when you hold it.

items.name: Static Jelly
items.lore: Tastes like licking a battery. Gets you moving, though.

items.name: Onsen Egg
items.lore: Slow-cooked in a geyser for exactly one hundred years.

items.name: Sulfur Gland
items.lore: Smells like a thousand rotten eggs. Alchemists love it.

items.name: Geyser Pearl
items.lore: Grown one boiling layer at a time inside a serpent's throat.

items.name: Lumen Berry
items.lore: Eat one and the dark steps back. A little.

items.name: Glimmer Mote
items.lore: Warm in your hand, like it is glad you are there.

items.name: Shade Essence
items.lore: Colder than it should be, and heavier than it looks.

items.name: Prism Fruit
items.lore: Cool and crisp. Tastes like the color turquoise.

items.name: Sand Worm Tooth
items.lore: One of four hundred. It grows a new one every week.

items.name: Glass Stinger
items.lore: Hollow, with a drop of pink venom still inside.

items.name: Blank Wafer
items.lore: Tastes of absolutely nothing. You become a little bit of nothing, too.

items.name: Shadow Ink
items.lore: Pours upward when nobody is watching.

items.name: Static Mote
items.lore: Hums at exactly sixty hertz. Hold it to your ear if you dare.
